idea-plugin.name: Helidon
idea-plugin.description:
Adds support for the Helidon framework for building Java microservices with Helidon SE and MP.

Features:

  • Create Helidon Maven projects from the IDE.
  • Navigate between Helidon services, injection points, and service registry lookups.
  • Discover Helidon WebServer and RestServer endpoints in the Endpoints tool window.
  • Open gutter navigation for Helidon routes, declarative HTTP endpoints, and declarative services.
  • Complete, inspect, document, and rename Helidon configuration keys in YAML and properties files.

Endpoints tool window, URL resolver and inlay support, declarative HTTP endpoint route navigation, and Helidon configuration assistance require IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate with the optional Microservices integration.
